observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated test-support facade with helper functions to create Role, RoleMembership, and AccessControl rows without importing production models.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces coupling between error-tracking query runner tests and access-control production models; tests use the facade instead of importing Role/AccessControl directly.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct model instantiation with the facade helper, changing the assignment argument from role to role_id.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows backfill command tests to assign roles without importing the production Role model, supporting the access-control boundary.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct model instantiation with the facade helper, changing the assignment argument from AccessControl to create_access_control.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows weekly digest temporal tests to create access-control rows without importing the production AccessControl model, supporting the access-control boundary.
